concept.description:
v3_illustrious have 2 files:
zoda_v3_illu_hires.safetensors (435MB, Hi-Res version , default option)

zoda_v3_illu.safetensors (218MB, Standard version )

Recommend all illustrious user give ANIMA (66MB) a try
Credit to @Choco_Tarte for v3 Beta test.

>> 🎉🎉 Checkout our Zoda Gallery 🎉🎉 <<
Zoda is a LoRA model designed to enhance detail and expression in NSFW generations.

Recommend Setting:
ILLU / PONY / SDXL :
Sampling : Euler A / DPM++ 2M SDE
Schedule: Karras / Exponential
Steps : 20+
Strength : 0.5 - 1.0 (0.5 if distorting in multi-LORA)

Anima :
scheduler: SimpleSteps: 30 - 45Strength: 1.2 - 1.8 (v1) , 1.0-1.2 (v2)

Tag means work best on tested model base, didn't mean only work on that model.
Illustrious / NoobAI / SDXL are Compatible, cross-apply Lora and models may give out some surprise🎉.
Recommend SDXL ❤️
Welcome to adapt to any SDXL branch, please post it and let me know. ❤️

This is my first model, and while it's not fully refined yet, it serves as a solid foundation for future improvements.
Feedback is always welcome — feel free to drop a comment below. Your input is greatly appreciated!
